mapper.select: WITH CONFIG AS ( SELECT SYSTEM_CONFIG_CD, SYSTEM_CONFIG_VALUE FROM DOCS_SYSTEM_CONFIG WHERE SYSTEM_CONFIG_CD LIKE 'UPDOWN%' ) SELECT MAX(SYSTEM_CONFIG_VALUE) FILTER (WHERE SYSTEM_CONFIG_CD = 'UPDOWN_SERVER_IP') AS "updownServerIp", MAX(SYSTEM_CONFIG_VALUE) FILTER (WHERE SYSTEM_CONFIG_CD = 'UPDOWN_SERVER_IP_OUT') AS "updownOutServerIp", MAX(SYSTEM_CONFIG_VALUE) FILTER (WHERE SYSTEM_CONFIG_CD = 'UPDOWN_SERVER_PORT') AS "updownServerPort", MAX(SYSTEM_CONFIG_VALUE) FILTER (WHERE SYSTEM_CONFIG_CD = 'UPDOWN_LANG_CODE') AS "updownLangCode", MAX(SYSTEM_CONFIG_VALUE) FILTER (WHERE SYSTEM_CONFIG_CD = 'UPDOWN_IS_SECURITY') AS "updownIsSecurity", MAX(SYSTEM_CONFIG_VALUE) FILTER (WHERE SYSTEM_CONFIG_CD = 'UPDOWN_USER_AUTH') AS "updownUserAuth" FROM CONFIG;

SELECT rf.FILE_PATH_NM AS filePathNm , rf.ORG_FILE_NM AS orgFileNm , rf.FILE_NM AS fileNm , rf.FILE_SIZE AS fileSize , rf.USE_END_YMD AS endDate , rf.OBJECT_ID AS objectId , rf.OBJECT_ID AS docSeq , rf.FILE_NO::text AS fileNo , rf.REQUEST_NO AS requestNo , r.OBJECT_TYPE AS objectType FROM DOCS_REQUEST_FILE rf JOIN DOCS_REQUEST r ON r.REQUEST_NO = rf.REQUEST_NO
( rf.OBJECT_ID = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{list.objectId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ''), #{list.docSeq, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND rf.REQUEST_NO = #{list.requestNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND rf.FILE_NO::text = #{list.fileNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR})

SELECT rf.FILE_PATH_NM AS filePathNm, rf.ORG_FILE_NM AS orgFileNm, rf.FILE_NM AS fileNm, rf.FILE_SIZE AS fileSize, rf.USE_END_YMD AS endDate, rf.OBJECT_ID AS objectId, rf.OBJECT_ID AS docSeq, rf.FILE_NO::text AS fileNo, rf.REQUEST_NO AS requestNo, r.OBJECT_TYPE AS objectType FROM DOCS_REQUEST_FILE rf JOIN DOCS_REQUEST r ON r.REQUEST_NO = rf.REQUEST_NO WHERE rf.REQUEST_NO = #{requestNo} AND rf.OBJECT_ID = #{objectId} AND rf.FILE_NO::text = #{fileNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DOCS_DOWN_HISTORY (REQUEST_NO, OBJECT_ID, DOWN_COUNT, OBJECT_NO, OBJECT_NM, USER_NM, DOWN_DATE, DOWNLOADED_NAME) VALUES (#{requestNo}, #{objectId} ,#{downCount}, #{objectNo}, #{objectNm}, #{userNm}, #{downDate}, #{downloadedName})

INSERT INTO DOCS_DOCUMENT_ACT_LOG (ACT_TYPE, ACT_TIME, PATH, UUID, OBJECT_ID, POLICY) VALUES ( #{act_type}, #{act_time}, #{path}, #{uuid}, (SELECT OBJECT_ID FROM DOCS_DOWN_HISTORY WHERE DOWNLOADED_NAME = #{uuid}), #{policy} )
mapper.select: SELECT rf.REQUEST_NO AS "requestNo", r.REQUEST_TYPE AS "requestType", rf.OBJECT_ID AS "objectId", rf.FILE_NO::text AS "fileNo", r.OBJECT_TYPE AS "objectType", COALESCE(r.PROTECT_YN, 'N') AS "protectYn", rf.ORG_FILE_NM AS "orgFileNm", rm.OBJECT_NO AS "objectNo", rm.OBJECT_NM AS "objectNm" FROM DOCS_REQUEST_FILE rf JOIN DOCS_REQUEST r ON r.REQUEST_NO = rf.REQUEST_NO LEFT JOIN DOCS_REQUEST_MAPPING rm ON rm.REQUEST_NO = rf.REQUEST_NO AND rm.OBJECT_ID = rf.OBJECT_ID WHERE rf.REQUEST_NO = #{requestNo} AND rf.OBJECT_ID = #{docSeq} AND (NULLIF(#{fileSeq}, '') IS NULL OR rf.FILE_NO::text = #{fileSeq}) ORDER BY rf.FILE_NO LIMIT 1
